facts.activity_file: benching, battering and shoring an excavation

control_failures.control_label: inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control GROUND_CONDITION_INSPECTION: the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters on P-3221 and M-3221 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in designing and controlling excavations, specifically benching, battering and shoring an excavation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the inspection and monitoring of highwalls and batters was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 26 November 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-3221 and M-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
